TEAKS : The greatest gift from nature

Everything starts from teaks in the Northeast of Thailand. They are valuable resource growing together with people in the region; they have been grown, taken care of, cut, and then replanted for years and years. Unlike teaks from other areas in the world, Thai teaks possess unique golden brown texture which can be seen even with naked eyes. We choose teaks due to their moisture resistance.

Their durability and lightweight are more than suitable to be utensil material.

 

HEARTCRAFTED : The greatest gifts from humans

Feeling grateful for every support that keeps their families together, they use their heart to carve utensils instead of only saying thank you. Back when they had no supporter, they to run around selling their products, leaving the kids and elders home.

Now that they have a little space to sell, they can build warmer and bigger families. Some even managed to take their kids to work and teach them how it is like to work by heart.
